name: Ise no Miyasudokoro
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 19); Porter gives no dates for this poet.

poems.title: Short as the joints of bamboo reeds
poems.author: Ise no Miyasudokoro
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 19
poems.text:
Short as the joints of bamboo reeds
That grow beside the sea
On pebble beach at Naniwa,
I hope the time may be,
When thou ’rt away from me.

poems.title: 19. 難波潟 短き葦の ふしのまも (Naniwagata mijikaki ashi no fushi no ma mo)
poems.author: Ise no Miyasudokoro
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 新古今集
poems.text:
難波潟 短き葦の ふしのまも
あはで此の世を すぐしてよとや
